steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: La la la la la... Hum hum hum hum...
Having come up with a new idea for a movie, the girl skips happily back to the filming car.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Phew... I'm in a good mood today. Shall I give that dummy clapper a promotion?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I wonder if he's getting along better with Stella... Um, what are they doing?
steps.female_content: I wonder if she's getting along better with Stella... Um, what are they doing?

steps.content: Spotting you and the little critter, OwO quickly hides behind a tree to observe.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: (Staring)

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr... purr?
You look around. The girl has temporarily left your sight. Now's a good time to catch the Apostle of Ashes.
You tiptoe towards the little critter, set yourself at the right distance, then pounce forward with all your might...

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr!
You lose your balance and almost fall to the ground. The little critter nimbly jumps up, steps over your back, and leaps into the girl's arms.
You decide to take a detour, using various obstacles to create blind spots as you quietly approach the little critter...

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr!
You almost succeeded! But the little creature still slipped through your fingers at the last minute and dashed into the girl's arms.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey hey hey, you're not allowed to bully Stella!
The girl stands before you with her hands on her hips, ready to uphold justice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ahem, I was just playing with Stella.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph, I don't believe you. You were clearly bullying Stella!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Right, Stella?

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr, purr...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: See, Stella agrees!
The little critter curls up in the girl's arms and whimpers piteously, but you clearly see it wagging its tail in triumph, and even secretly wink at you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I think that exotic animals of unknown origin are best left to the care of professionals. Why don't...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: No its not! Come to think of it... the only person of unknown origin is you, dummy clapper!

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr, purr...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph! You disobey the director's orders and repeatedly disrupt the team! How should I punish you?

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr! Purr!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Seeing how hard you've worked for me, I'll spare you this time!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But I still want to test your mettle... Write me a movie script in one day!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Clearly it's because you're too lazy to write it yourself...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What... Don't you dare insult OwO! A test is a test! Come on, Stella, let's go.
The girl skips away with the little critter in her arms.
The comms panel is flickering. You got a message. You quickly go to the side to check it out.

steps.speaker: MBCC Clerk
steps.content:
Wynn: Ah! Looks like you got my message, Chief ${PlayerName}! I'm the clerk for the city arrest team. My code name is "Wynn"! ('·ω·')

Wynn: How is the plan to capture the Apostle of Ashes coming along? (.・ω・.)
The clerk of the city arrest team? Her name sounds quite familiar. You wrack your brain, trying to remember.
You remember your first day at the Bureau.
So it's her. She's already in charge of matters related to the Apostle of Ashes? The scope of the city arrest team's work is really extensive.

steps.speaker: MBCC Clerk
steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> Everything's fine.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color>Everything's fine? Wow, that's great to hear! (/·ω·)/

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> I knew it! With ${PlayerName} personally taking the reins, everything is sure to be fine! (。>ω<)/

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Why did you go quiet of all a sudden, ${PlayerName}? Is something wrong? (。OωO。)

steps.speaker: MBCC Clerk
steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> Things are tough.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Things are tough? Let me guess... It's because of that kid named OwO. ('·ω·')


<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Are you afraid that she'll be sad if you take away the Apostle of Ashes? Tsk tsk. ${PlayerName}, you really are a kind soul. (/TAT)/
<size=40>You brief her on the situation.</size>

steps.speaker: MBCC Clerk
steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color>Got any suggestions?


<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Well, I do have some experience when it comes to dealing with kids. ('·ω·')

<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> What annoys kids the most is when adults lecture and talk down to them. (¯¯-¯¯o)


<color=#fb9259>Wynn:</color> Maybe you can turn what you want to tell her into a story? (>□<)b

steps.speaker: MBCC Clerk
steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}:</color> Hmm...
Wynn: You can do it, Chief! I believe in you! (。OvO。)

Wynn: I've got a feeling that you're a great storyteller! (。>ω<)b
Thus, you pour all your energy and concentration into writing a script. By the time you finish, it's already night.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ah... Why did you call me over? I'm sleepy, aha...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't you want to test me? I just finished my script. Why don't I tell you about it now?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm? A bedtime story? I'm not a little kid who needs to listen to stories anymore. I just want to sleep right now...
The girl has already forgotten that she wanted to test you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did you forget that you wanted to test my mettle?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Test? Test what... Oh! I remember now! I-I didn't forget at all! This is part of the test, too! Hmph...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All right, then. Let me tell you the story of "Super Lion."

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: A superhero lion? I love lions!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Stella, come listen with me...

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr...
